title: Orchestrate INT8 weight-only profiles + regression harness and flaky-test mitigation (GPTQ/AWQ)
creator: Ravi Patel
description:
Goal: Wire up weight-only INT8 quantization profiles (GPTQ + AWQ variants) into our CI/regression harness, add targeted calibration workflows, and eliminate flakiness observed in nightly accuracy checks. This ticket covers orchestration, test selection, and mitigation steps so model accuracy regressions are caught early without blocking rollout cadence.

Scope:
- Add new profile metadata and CLI to generate per-model INT8 profile bundles (metadata + calibration seeds).
- Extend regtest harness to run both GPTQ and AWQ profiles in parallel on representative seed sets.
- Add statistical accuracy checks (median + tail percentiles) and rollback gates for canaries.
- Implement flaky-test detection and isolation rules: automatic rerun, result caching, and tagging of nondeterministic cases.

Out of scope for this ticket: full FP8 pipeline integration, on-prem packaging, and UI changes in Console (those are follow-ups).
acceptance_criteria: CI can ingest profile bundles and run GPTQ + AWQ calibration on nightly runners
Regression harness produces deterministic summary artifacts (CSV + JSON) with median, 90th, 95th token-level accuracy deltas
Flaky failures are auto-retried with a threshold; flaky tests are flagged in dashboard and do not block release unless >5% divergence
Playbook documented for rolling back a quantization profile rollout including linked GitHub PR and runtime feature flag
End-to-end run time for the nightly quantization regression suite stays under 6 hours via sharding and spot runners
test_plans: nightly-quant-regressions: run on ubuntu-latest with 8xA100 shard, seed set v2 (100 prompts)
canary-smoke: run light-profile (10 prompts) against dedicated canary cluster before rollout
stress-kv: validate KV cache correctness under quantized weights with long-context prompts
determinism-suite: 3x reruns to detect nondeterminism and measure variance
steps: Define profile bundle schema and add exporter in quant-tooling repo
Implement runner adapter to unpack profile bundles and select GPTQ/AWQ binary paths
Add sharding and seed scheduling to reduce tail latency of nightly jobs
Integrate statistical checks and thresholds into regression harness (prometheus + CSV outputs)
Create flaky-test detector that marks tests as flaky after 2 out of 3 non-deterministic runs
Add automated PR comments with regression summaries and link to failing artifacts
notes: Observed intermittent 0.3-1.2% perplexity spike on AWQ runs on the previous harness (logged in ENG-31741). Hypothesis: non-deterministic calibration seeds and differing kernel selections under heavy GC load.
Trade-offs: running both GPTQ and AWQ doubles compute budget for nightly runs. Mitigation: sharded runs + selective sampling of heavy models for AWQ only.
We intentionally avoid conservative rollback thresholds to reduce false positives for small token-level deltas; use median + tail checks instead of mean alone.
Plan to follow up with a dedicated FP8 ticket after INT8 baseline stabilizes.
